intro: The Meraki display unit and bookshelf bring effortless elegance to your space. Designed to showcase and organise, it turns your books and treasures into a beautiful visual story.

features.title: Effortless quality, undeniable style
features.text: Built with 18 mm thick prelaminated particle board, ensuring a sturdy, reliable structure that stands the test of time.

features.title: Push-to-open glass for clean design
features.text: Features sleek toughened glass with a push-to-open mechanism for a clean, seamless, and user-friendly design.

features.title: High-gloss PU lamination finish
features.text: Enhanced with a premium Noce Versailles and Ecru high-gloss finish, offering a sophisticated touch that complements modern interiors.

features.title: Compact dimensions for versatile placement
features.text: Its thoughtfully designed dimensions make it perfect for any space, offering flexibility in placement and effortless style integration.

features.title: Knock-down design for easy assembly
features.text: Engineered for a quick and hassle-free setup, making it a convenient addition to your living room essentials.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
